title: TopologyV2ViewCatalogItem
description: UI-safe catalog item for a topology v2 view template.

viewId.description: Stable identifier used by the UI to request resolve/stream.

version.description: View definition version (does not change viewId).

origin.description: Whether the item is a system view or a saved custom view.

ownerUserId.description: Owner of the custom view when origin=custom.

sharingScope.description: Sharing model for the custom view when origin=custom.

scopeMode.description: Portability mode for a saved custom view.

baseTemplateViewId.description: Stable base template reference for a saved custom view.

scopeTypes.description: Which scopes this view can be resolved for.

appliesWhen.description: Optional predicate used by the UI to show relevant views for the current context.
